text:
noah: Acme security just asked: can we contractually commit to 24h purge for POC tenant? Also want language for DPA + SCCs and sample DSAR intake. cc @tanya @sam

tanya: Short: Hosted default is 30d per DPA. For POC we can offer an addendum that requires manual purge within 24h on receipt of a valid DSAR, but product-level 24h SLA requires Dedicated or SOW.

sam: Adding technical detail for their security ops: manual purge flow (sanitized):

```bash
# internal admin purge (sanitized example)
POST /internal/admin/purge -d '{"customer_id":"acme-poc","request_id":"dsar-001"}'
# returns 202 -> async purge job queued; audit log created
```

sam: Note: Hosted purge path performs soft-delete -> async GC (usually completes within 24-72h). We can expedite on request but can't guarantee automated 24h without contract.

noah: They also asked if request/response text is included in DSAR exports and whether logs contain PII. Tanya?

tanya: Yes — customer-submitted content is included in DSAR exports. Access logs (IP, UA) are treated as system metadata: hosted retention 90d for access logs, 30d for request payloads by default. We can provide full-text export via admin export API for POCs.

legal-liaison: For the reply, reference our DPA link and note SCC support. If we propose a 24h POC addendum, include: "manual purge upon receipt of DSAR, evidence provided via audit log entry and purge job ID". Sam — please attach sanitized export command. I'll prepare redline template.

sam: Export snippet (sanitized):
```
GET /internal/admin/export?customer_id=acme-poc&format=fulltext
```

noah: Great. I'll send the short response to Acme with the two snippets and ask if they want a temporary addendum. Thanks everyone :pray:
